title: bus.github.issue v1
description: Emitted by the github-relay adapter (adapters/github-relay/) on a state TRANSITION observed for a GitHub Issue on a roster repo (`gh issue list --state all`), diffed against persisted state (~/.cache/nervous-bus/github-relay/state.json): a new issue, a state change (opened/closed/reopened), a new comment, or a label change. Never emitted per-poll for an unchanged issue. Pull requests are always excluded (`is_pull_request` is present only for schema future-proofing against a GitHub API change; `gh issue list` itself never returns PRs today -- verified 2026-08-30). Closes the estate's GitHub-Issues gap: ci-watch/maintenance-train cover Actions + PRs, nothing previously ingested Issues. Consumers: deer-flow SSE, bead-filing inside github-relay itself, and (future) any dashboard wanting issue-level signal alongside ci.pipeline.status.v1 / bus.dependabot.alerts.v1.

repo.description: owner/name of the GitHub repository (e.g. warxhead1/hearth-loom)

action.description: Why this event fired: a lifecycle transition, a new comment count, a label-set change, an assignee change, or an updatedAt bump not otherwise classified (`updated`).

state.description: GitHub issue state at observation time (gh's `state` field, lowercased).

labels.description: Label names currently on the issue.

author.description: GitHub login of the issue author (gh's `author.login`).

body_excerpt.description: Issue body truncated to 500 chars (never redacted for content -- only truncated; this is a PUBLIC repo's public issue text).

comment_count.description: Number of comments on the issue at observation time (len of gh's `comments` array).

is_pull_request.description: Always false -- PR-shaped issues are filtered out before an event is ever built; kept in the schema so a future ingestion path that does see PRs fails validation loudly instead of silently mixing PR events into this channel.

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the measurement (gh's `updatedAt` for the issue, normalized to Z).
